title: Sleeps 24! Broadway Views, Rooftops & Karaoke
description:
Experience Nashville luxury across two facing units with stunning Printer's Alley, speakeasy, and karaoke/podcast themes! This property sleeps 24 guests with 8 bedrooms, 9 bathrooms, custom murals, and fully equipped kitchens. The show-stopping rooftop deck features a putting green, fire table, and sweeping skyline views. Perform in the karaoke/podcast stage room with wet bar. Located minutes from Broadway and downtown, it's perfect for large groups seeking an unforgettable Nashville experience!
